content: There is a new build up on the testing server. A lot of the bullet velocities have been changed. You should only notice it at far distances. Also since the bullet velocities are now slower (what they used to be) you should be able to see the actual bullets now too.

So some background. Originally we had the bullet velocities similar to real life velocities. There was a bug though that when people would run perpendicular to you, your bullets would not hit them. In order to fix the bug we made the bullet velocities 10x what they used to be. We then fixed the bug properly and so are now testing putting back bullet velocities to their real life values. You should not really notice a difference outside of having to lead people running perpendicular to you at a very far distance.

To access the test server add you need to add &tester=true to the end of the URL while the game is loading and then hit reload. Once you have connected, join the testing server. ELO changes are turned off for the test server so you do not have to worry about your ELO changing while trying out the test server.

content: Friends system. Use the friends tab on the main menu to find your friends and play with them.

Spectator mode if you join a full server or game in progress of Battle Royale. If you join a friends server and it is full you will be put in spectator mode. As soon as a free slot opens you will join your friends server.
Various tweaks to bullet speeds to improve the feel of shooting at people when they are running perpendicular to you. This should make firing at people in the short to medium range feel better.

Removed the floatiness of the player in the game by increasing the gravity. Parkour can still be done as we increased the jump speed to compensate for the gravity increase. You will now be able to jump a little higher than normal.

content: New parachute simulation. In Battle Royale you have free fall then press F to open your parachute and glide. If you don't press F your parachute will automatically open before you hit the ground. In regular mode you just have the parachuting portion.

Improved Missile Launch/Bomb Disposal gameplay. Now the missile on its own drops at 1/10th the speed it used to. To drop it faster the defending team needs to press F next to the missile/bomb to drop it faster. Players can no longer choose a missile launch to parachute down on. There is a 100m radius circle around the missile where players cannot drop. It will show up as a faint red circle around the missile launcher on the map.
Missile locations on all levels balanced better. Now missile launchers will be more in the middle of the map between each base.
Option to Spectate or Play New Game on Battle Royale mode.
Credit opposite team with a point in death match if you crash a plane or self destruct.
Press 5 to swap grenade types in Battle Royale mode if you have both of them.
If you have both types of grenades in Battle Royale and run out of one, the other type will be equipped.
The player will now play an animation while using first aid in Battle Royale mode, so you can snipe someone while they are healing. :-)
Made the edge of the circle "safe area" in Battle Royale mode more obvious. It should now be easier to see especially when the circle gets smaller.
Now when you are in the dangerous red zone in Battle Royale mode the whole screen is tinted red to make it more obvious when you are in or out of the red zone.
Added a caret to the compass in Battle Royale mode which shows the direction for the shortest distance to the safe area as well as a digital distance to that point.
Right clicking on the Grenade in Battle Royale mode will equip it.
Tweaked transparent materials to render faster.
Fixed the scale and orientation of weapon attachments on weapons in regular mode.
Made smoke grenades more sticky so when you are on a slight slope they come to a stop and start smoking. They will still roll down the hill on steep slopes.
Made the red dot on the red dot scope 50% smaller so it is easier to see what you are shooting at with it.
Reduced the flickering of distance objects when parachuting.
Fixed bug where sound of climbing ladders was not playing.
Fixed bug where being on a ladder when the plane started resulted in you dropping without your parachute.
Fixed doors on motel so that it is easier to go in/out of the rooms.

Fixed players being able to parachute spawn on a player that is in slew mode (admin). This will make it so the admin can spectate/broadcast squad wars and not have one team be able to parachute on his camera position.
Reduced triangle count on all emblems and flags. Visually they will be the same but each one saves 200 triangles which will help performance slightly.
Fixed emblems flickering on players shoulders.
Added ramps to the stairs at the train station.

content: NOTE:
To access the test server on a browser client do the following:

Log into the game and hit play. While the game is loading or after it is complete (when does not matter) add "&tester=true" without the quotes to the end of the URL in the URL bar (see image at the end of this post). Hit enter to reload the game with that URL.
When the game loads you should now see a server titled USA_Testing.
Connect to that server and test the level.
To access the test server on a steam client do the following:
Hop into a game using the steam client.
Open up the chat and type "client testing" without the quotes and hit enter.
Exit out to the server select screen. You should now see a server titled USA_Testing.
Connect to that server and test the level.

content: New map: ESCAPE - This is a tight quarters out door map for guaranteed non-stop action!
New weapons Revolver. The Revolver is a 6 round pistol with a 6x scope. It has a lot of kick but can down an enemy with a shot to the body and a shot to the head.

Vehicles are invulnerable in their home position or with no driver. This is to prevent the enemy team from blowing up the vehicles before your team can get in them.

content: Sniper rifle has ballistic bullets meaning they fall with distance. The farther your shot the more you need to aim above their head to hit.

Updated sniper rifle scope graphic. You can use the scope to measure a players distance from you and then aim at the appropriate marker to hit them exactly where you are aiming. To find out their distance line up their feet with the center horizontal line of the scope. Then while keeping their feet on the center line figure out which horizontal mark above the center line their head lines up with. That will be the distance they are at. Next line up the corresponding horizontal mark below the center line at the distance you measured. Your bullet will now hit that spot when you fire if you measured the distance correctly.

content: Moved ladder on vat in flooded level to face team direction

New flight params for each copter. LVL1 heli is a little slower, LVL2 heli is very maneuverable (it is going to eventually get replaced by a new heli with these parameters), LVL3 is the same, and the Flood Level heli is slower.
Now when you bail out of a heli you automatically open a parachute. You can use WASD to maneuver your parachute while dropping.
While parachuting you can pull out your pistol and fire at others.
Added a X hit marker when you damage something - white is a normal hit, orange is a head shot hit, red is a kill shot hit.
Adjust health bar above vehicles and people to see closer
Added melee attacks, Use the middle mouse button or the 4 key to draw the knife. It does 200 damage if you hit an enemy in the front. It will do 400 damage if you hit an enemy in the back.

Some code fixes for close quarters battles. In the past in close quarters when you circle strafed an enemy your shots would actually go off to the left or right depending on which direction you were circle strafing. Now they go where you are aiming.

Lag predicition. If an enemy is moving perpendicular to you and you have a high latency the enemy would have moved by the time your bullet was registered on the server. Now the server looks back in time to see if the bullet hit the character. So if it looks like you hit them on your screen the server will register it as a hit.
Sniper rifle accuracy improved by 50%
